facts.fact: The Respondents reports on 7 October 2026 that the PDPC is training DPOs on requirements under the Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44, and that institutions collecting personal data must register with the Commission.
The PDPC is acting: it ran the eighth phase of its DPO training programme in Morogoro on 7-8 October 2026 for more than 300 participants.
PDPC figures cited by the article show 15,146 institutions registered and 445 personal-data complaints received by August 2026, with no decisions or sanctions stated.
